title: Interest Months on a Late Reimbursement Bill in Employer Benefit Charging Protests
content:
For a written protest of Employer Benefit Charging charges that disputes the employer's base-period wages or its base-period status, the number of interest months measures how long the reimbursement bill for the statement's quarter has run past its due date. The bill, its due date and the payments applied to it are those shown on the employer's Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts record for that quarter.

## Rule

The number of interest months is, when the latest payment applied to the reimbursement bill for the statement's quarter was received after the bill's due date, the whole months from the due date to that payment plus one for the month in which it fell; when no payment has been applied to that bill and its due date has passed, the whole months from the due date to the protest plus one for the month in which the protest falls; and none otherwise.

## Calendar conventions

- **The bill and its due date** are the reimbursement bill entered on the tax account for the statement's quarter and the bill due date it carries; where several bills are entered for that quarter, the most recently entered one is used.
- **A payment applied to the bill** is a payment received on the tax account and applied to the reimbursement for that quarter. A payment applied to another component of the quarter, such as interest or a penalty, is not a payment applied to the bill. Where several payments have been applied to the bill, the latest one is the one compared with the due date.
- **The protest date** is the day the protest is lodged.
- **A whole month** is completed each time the calendar reaches the due date's day of the month again. A payment or protest dated on the due date itself is not after it.

## Cases (hypothetical dates)

| Bill due | Payments applied to the bill | Protest lodged | Whole months | Interest months |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 15 March | 2 May | — | 1 (15 April reached, 15 May not) | 2 |
| 15 March | 15 May | — | 2 | 3 |
| 15 March | 15 March | — | Paid on the due date, not after it | None |
| 15 March | 10 March, and an interest payment on 2 May | — | Latest payment applied to the bill is 10 March, not after the due date | None |
| 20 January | None | 5 April | 2 (20 February and 20 March reached) | 3 |
| 20 January | None | 10 January | Due date not yet passed | None |

Where no reimbursement bill is entered for the statement's quarter — as for an employer that finances benefits by contributions — no interest month is counted.
